topics.description: Multiple sources indicate a large-scale fraud investigation into Minnesota daycare centers. The probe may result in zero arrests according to a sting operation.
topics.reason: Potential large-scale fraud and lack of arrests

topics.description: New York and New Jersey are suing the Trump administration over a $16 billion funding freeze for the Gateway Hudson Tunnel project. Taxpayers may be on the hook for millions.
Fulton County is seeking the return of 2020 election documents seized by the FBI. This is part of a larger investigation into election integrity.
